basics.name: Ryan Dormanesh
basics.label: Game Designer · Founder, Funtownarcade Games
basics.summary: Game designer with 20+ years in games, from QA and technical design on Rockstar's Red Dead Redemption to level design and live ops on mobile hits like Cookie Jam and Tropical Treats. Founder of Funtownarcade Games LLC, an independent studio in Washington State.

work.name: Funtownarcade Games LLC
work.summary: Independent studio in Washington State. Released Caveman Runner 2.0 for iPhone and Treasure Drop on Google Play, running an open playtest of Slippery Delivery on Roblox, and developing NumMerge (planned November 2026), Every Card Counts Solitaire, and Hexa.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Led client projects end to end, from requirements and scope through documentation, timelines, and delivery. For Xpriential's treadmill workout platform, built multi-mile street-race environments recreated from real city streets, plus Unity editor tools that let the team build new locations quickly. Also delivered a polished mobile puzzle game with online features.

work.name: ESTsoft Inc. · Perfect Swing - Golf
work.position: Assistant Project Manager, Live Ops & Global Launch
work.summary: Ran live operations for Perfect Swing - Golf on iOS and Android, led QA for global launches, managed a remote QA team, and led App Store and Google Play submissions that earned featured placements.

work.name: MobilityWare · Tropical Treats
work.summary: Designed levels, modes, and obstacles in Unity for a match-3 puzzle game, introduced live events with a seasonal event and mission system, and set level design and tuning best practices for the team.

work.name: Jam City · Cookie Jam Series
work.summary: Designed and tuned match-3 levels for Cookie Jam and Cookie Jam Blast, delivering weekly content to millions of players. Mentored a team of five level designers, wrote specs for new live event features, and worked with engineers day to day to build them, including a leaderboard race event.

work.name: BrickLink
work.summary: Managed quality for an online LEGO marketplace with 400,000 users and 9,000 active stores, including test plans for the inventory system, catalog, and storefront, cross-browser and mobile testing, and Selenium automation.

work.name: Checkpoint Studios · AviNation
work.summary: Designed gameplay mechanics, economy, and quests for a social airport simulator, scripted mechanics in C# in Unity, and led the QA department.

work.name: Zynga · FarmVille & Café World
work.summary: Led QA for Café World content releases and new features for over 2 million daily players, coordinating with external QA teams and partner studios. Ran localization testing for FarmVille, working with external translators and QA teams. Voted "Chef of the Week" by the team.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Red Dead Redemption
work.summary: Built the game's animation state machines, 600+ in all: the player's moves and weapons, multiplayer, minigames, unique story-mission moments, and the ambient life of its people and animals. Trained and led a team of designers on in-house tools.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Rockstar Presents Table Tennis
work.summary: Led 15 QA analysts and two remote teams on the first game built on Rockstar's RAGE engine. Ran technical testing and automated tests on the engine, worked with programmers to build automated load tests, hosted playtests and gave designers balance feedback, and ran Microsoft certification for the Xbox 360 launch.

work.name: Rockstar San Diego · Midnight Club 3: Dub Edition
work.summary: QA on an open-world street racer with online multiplayer, including team capture-the-flag and elimination race modes. Found and documented gameplay, crash, and multiplayer bugs, and tracked Sony's Technical Certification Requirements through sign-off.

projects.name: Caveman Runner 2.0
projects.summary: The 2011 iPhone endless runner, rebuilt for today's iPhones with 120 Hz play and iPhone Duo support.

projects.name: NumMerge
projects.summary: A puzzle game about chaining numbered balls in order to merge them. Planned for the App Store and Google Play in November 2026.

projects.name: Treasure Drop
projects.summary: A pachinko-style ball-drop arcade game, out now on Google Play.

projects.name: Slippery Delivery
projects.summary: A momentum-based delivery racer, in open playtest on Roblox.

projects.name: Guess Quest
projects.summary: A high or low card betting game made in one day.

projects.name: Caveman Runner (original)
projects.summary: An early iPhone endless runner, co-developed with Tom Carroll.
